Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the enrichment and characterization of chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans (CSPGs). It uses a combination of MWCO filtration and SAX chromatography for enrichment, followed by chondroitinase ABC digestion to leave a linker hexasaccharide on the serine residue for MS analysis. Fragmentation used both stepped HCD and EtHCD for site localization.

scope: the peptide mixture was enriched for glycosaminoglycan (GAG)-linked peptides

The trypsin-digested samples were divided equally to be enriched with two different strategies, namely filtration with 10 kDa molecular weight cutoff filters (MWCO) and strong anion exchange chromatography (SAX).
The GAG-linked peptides were enriched using SAX TopTips (POROS strong anion exchanger TopTip TT2PSA, Glygen).
The retentate containing GAG-linked peptides present in the filter was inverted into a fresh collection tube
